notes: Offline source audit completed 2026-09-08 by claude-india-media3-20260822. Covers three India records: SRM Institute of Science and Technology (Kattankulathur campus only), KIIT Deemed to be University (Bhubaneswar), and Lovely Professional University (Phagwara). Logos are sourced from each institution's own official domain (the header/brand-asset file actually served on the live site, or KIIT's dedicated public downloads page). Covers are sourced from the institution's own domain where a campus-identifiable official image exists (KIIT), otherwise from a Wikimedia Commons file whose file page states an explicit reusable licence and whose title/description confirms the correct campus (SRM Kattankulathur, LPU Phagwara). No asset was downloaded, uploaded, or applied to the database.

entries.universityName: SRM Institute of Science and Technology

logo.rightsBasis: official brand asset: the primary header logo served directly from the university's own official domain (www.lpu.in), confirmed live and returning image/svg+xml
